readiness.draft is {"present":null,"chars":null} in both conversations. The composer probe sets present to a boolean, so a null present proves readiness exited before the composer probe ran.
The conversation identity {"state":"unbound","reason":"NEW_CHAT"} and the target identity {"state":"unverified","reason":"UNSUPPORTED_PATH"} disagree in vocabulary for the same tab.

node bin/studio.mjs targets --port 38702 --json exits 5 with code ENVIRONMENT and message "Capture browser not available or not verified: BROWSER_PROFILE_UNVERIFIED: A Chrome endpoint is reachable but its identity is not verified for this VIVIM profile. Do not attach or send; close only the dedicated VIVIM Chrome after saving your work, then relaunch with studio start."

causeHypothesis.statement: The page-level location.origin sample for a freshly created ChatGPT tab never equals "https://chatgpt.com", so creationLocation() throws BINDING_CHANGED on every readiness tick and the deadline verdict is BINDING_CHANGED even though the target-level url origin matches.
codePath: src/capture/conversation-browser-adapter.mjs:121-122 computes the target-level origin from target.url and compares it with binding.origin; both are "https://chatgpt.com", so the target-level check passes and the about:blank tolerance at :123-127 is never reached.

src/capture/conversation-browser-adapter.mjs:132 reduces to pageThreadMatches() only, because threadMatches() is defined as !binding.thread || sameThread(...) at :74 and binding.thread is absent for a fresh conversation.

src/capture/conversation-browser-adapter.mjs:134-140 calls creationLocation() for a fresh threadless tab; :107-108 samples location.pathname and then throws BINDING_CHANGED when location.origin !== binding.origin.

src/capture/conversation-browser-adapter.mjs:141-157 catches that throw, re-derives the target origin, and because it equals binding.origin it does not escalate; it only records lastReason = BINDING_CHANGED and loops.
The loop repeats until the deadline and returns blocked(lastReason), which is BINDING_CHANGED with the default draft {present:null,chars:null} from :115. That matches the captured draft exactly.
supportingEvidence: readiness.draft.present is null, so the composer probe below :160 was never reached on any tick.
readiness.reason is BINDING_CHANGED while the target-level origin already matches, which points at the page-level sample rather than the target-level url.
The bound tab 2FB0E3DC shows target.url carrying no path, so the url field is a normalized origin-only value and cannot be used to infer what the page reports for location.origin.
causeHypothesis.notProven: The captured JSON does not contain the raw value returned by d.evaluate(livePage(), "location.origin"), so the exact returned string is not observed. It also does not show whether freshTab was true, whether the tab was mid-navigation for the whole window, or whether the CDP page used for evaluate was the right target. The service-level reason mapping at src/capture/conversation-service.mjs:625 emits BINDING_CHANGED for both a failed exactBinding and an adapter refusal carrying code BINDING_CHANGED, so the reason string alone cannot distinguish the two.
causeHypothesis.statusReason: The retest discriminated and falsified the prediction: readiness.reason changed from BINDING_CHANGED to null and readiness.draft.present changed from null to false, which proves the binding refusal path was not taken. A hypothesis that predicted an unchanged failure and observed a removed failure is not supported.
